items.prompt:
"Create an ultra-realistic cinematic fashion editorial photograph of an adult woman(match face) in a whimsical pink doll-inspired studio setting.

Appearance: A short blonde bob haircut with straight blunt bangs, soft glamorous makeup with defined eyes, rosy cheeks, glossy pink lips, luminous realistic skin, and a playful, confident expression.

Outfit: A structured strapless pastel-pink corset bodice with elegant vertical boning details, paired with a voluminous layered pink tulle tutu skirt. Matching pink ankle-strap heels with delicate bow embellishments complete the coordinated doll-inspired styling. The outfit is polished, playful, and fashion-forward.

Pose: She stands gracefully inside a large recessed rectangular pink display frame, balancing on one leg while the other leg bends elegantly across the front. One hand is raised near her lips in a playful blowing-a-kiss gesture while the other rests lightly near her shoulder. Natural anatomy and believable balance.

Setting: A monochromatic pastel-pink studio designed like an oversized collectible fashion-doll display box, with pink walls, floor, recessed frame, and subtle dimensional architectural details. A large stylized "Barbie" inspired script sign appears along the lower foreground of the display.

Lighting: Soft diffused studio lighting, gentle pink ambient illumination, subtle highlights on the satin corset and translucent tulle layers, controlled shadows, polished commercial fashion aesthetic.

Photography: Ultra-realistic editorial photography, authentic skin texture, detailed individual hair strands, realistic satin and tulle textures, natural anatomy, crisp footwear details, cinematic depth of field, refined color grading, high-end fashion campaign finish.

Composition: Full-body vertical portrait, centered subject, symmetrical doll-box framing, generous negative space around the figure, playful editorial composition, 9:16 aspect ratio."
items.title: 电影感女性人像
